purpose: Separate asymmetric QKV allocation from arithmetic mean LR multiplier on the learnable Mac binding task
lr_source: Selected on development seed 401 in parent experiment; fixed before this experiment; no new tuning or best-checkpoint selection
primary_metric: Final original-test CE after exactly 1200 updates; paired feature-minus-control deltas at each factor level
secondary_metrics: sampled validation CE mean over updates 50 through 1200
first sampled update at 90 percent validation accuracy
per-slice and combined applied QKV update RMS
binding_gate: original and rebound accuracy at least 90 percent and obsolete-target accuracy at most 20 percent; gate failures are retained, not excluded
controls: identical initialization/data/batch order/LR traces per seed; slice trust on; LR and spectral adaptation off; all other Tiger settings unchanged
measurement: Every update records actual post-optimizer-minus-pre-optimizer QKV parameter deltas. Per-slice RMS pools all layers; combined RMS pools all QKV entries. Equal mean LR multipliers do not guarantee equal applied update RMS after trust/clipping or divergent gradients

mps_replay.purpose: Supplementary first-seed replay of the unit-mean allocation contrast after the CPU study; no device parity or speed claim

interpretation: Conditional factorial effects on this short synthetic task and inherited LR; no general optimizer or LoRA claim
timing: Diagnostic only; host load uncontrolled and update measurement adds overhead
